description: A quick, fixed questionnaire: from the revenue source, creators per month, new sign-ups or installs a day and a few yes/no answers, it says whether WhichPost is a good fit now, which plan suits, and the next step. The same answers always give the same result; answers are not stored. Needs no sign-in.

creators_per_month.description: How many creators the team pays for posts in a typical month.

has_paying_customers.description: Whether the product already has paying customers.

history_days_before_campaign.description: Days of sales history before the campaign's first post.

is_agency.description: Whether this is an agency running creators for clients.

new_signups_per_day.description: New sign-ups, trials or installs on a typical day.

revenue_source.description: Where the product's payments are recorded. 'none' if it has no payments yet.

spark_ads_only.description: Whether the campaign runs only as TikTok Spark Ads.

name: check_fit
title: Is WhichPost a fit?
